intro: The moment you take the artifact from the Equinex Monolith, the power in the Stave of Equinex starts to fade. You are to bring the Sparkling Stone and the stave back to Troyas Moonbreeze at Feathermoon Stronghold.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The moment the artifact is removed from the Monolith, you feel the energy in the Stave of Equinex begin to fade.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I am glad you have returned, friend. I am eager to hear of your findings.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I have been reading since you left, friend. This stone you have found is called the Morrow Stone. While I am not entirely sure what its purpose is yet, you can be sure that it is something of great significance to be hidden away inside the Equinex Monolith the way it was.
I will continue my studies, and I hope I will be able to count on you in the future, friend. Thank you for all your help.
